verdict.rationale: A downloadable API spec is a fair question for a database with a managed cloud service, so the axis applies. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404, and no evidence item documents a machine-readable API spec. The llms.txt docs index, the MCP server and the ccloud CLI are different capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
